functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow authenticated users to log in with valid credentials
functional_requirements.rationale: Enables user access to the application functionality

acceptance_criteria.text: Given valid username and password, when user submits login form, then system authenticates user and redirects to dashboard

functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow authenticated users to log out securely
functional_requirements.rationale: Ensures session security and proper cleanup
postconditions: User is redirected to login page

acceptance_criteria.text: Given authenticated user, when user clicks logout, then system terminates session and redirects to login page
